title: QuASAR: Toward an LLM-Assisted Framework for Screening, Prototyping, and Assessing Quantum-Advantage Opportunities in Scientific Computing
abstract: arXiv:2611.27778v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Identifying scientific computations that could benefit from quantum algorithms requires both domain knowledge and fluency in quantum algorithm design, expertise that rarely resides in one person. We report results from QuASAR, an experimental, two-agent, LLM-driven pipeline intended to bridge this gap. One agent screens scientific literature for computational kernels with a plausible quantum-algorithmic analogue and proposes candidates, each backed by citations. A second agent independently verifies those citations. For candidates that survive verification, it reconstructs the source's computational structure, formulates a quantum mapping, builds and executes a prototype, and benchmarks it against classical baselines. We applied this pipeline to ten candidate computations drawn from the astrophysics literature. Nine candidates were carried through to a small-scale, benchmarked prototype. We report three in detail, chosen as the clearest

translated_title: QuASAR：迈向一种用于筛选、原型设计与评估科学计算中量子优势机会的LLM辅助框架
translated_abstract: 识别可能从量子算法中受益的科学计算，既需要领域知识，又需要量子算法设计方面的熟练能力，而这些专业知识很少同时存在于一个人身上。我们报告了QuASAR的结果，这是一个实验性的、由双智能体LLM驱动的流水线，旨在弥合这一差距。第一个智能体筛选科学文献，寻找具有合理量子算法对应物的计算内核，并提出候选方案，每个候选方案均有引文支持。第二个智能体独立验证这些引文。对于通过验证的候选方案，该智能体会重建源文献的计算结构，制定量子映射，构建并执行原型，并将其与经典基线进行基准测试。我们将该流水线应用于从天体物理学文献中提取的十项候选计算。九项候选计算被推进到小规模、经过基准测试的原型阶段。我们详细报告了其中三项，它们被选为最清晰的案例
tldr: QuASAR提出了一种由两个LLM智能体组成的实验性流水线，通过筛选文献中具有量子算法对应物的计算内核、独立验证引文、构建量子映射原型并与经典基线进行基准对比，来评估科学计算中的量子优势机会，在天体物理学的十项候选计算中成功完成了九项小规模基准原型。
en_tdlr: QuASAR is an experimental two-agent LLM-driven pipeline that screens scientific literature for computations with plausible quantum-algorithmic analogues, independently verifies citations, and builds and benchmarks quantum prototypes against classical baselines, successfully carrying nine of ten astrophysics candidates through to small-scale benchmarked prototypes.
